title: 738. My Calendar II

examples.explanation: Only the [5,15) request would pile three bookings over [10,15).

hints: Alongside the stored bookings, keep every pairwise-overlapped (double-covered) segment.
A new request fails when it overlaps any double-covered segment; otherwise append its overlaps with existing bookings to that list.
Overlap of [s,e) with [a,b) is [max(s,a), min(e,b)) whenever max < min.
